notes: Not chosen, 2026-11-08: Andrew took the Decofy 47" (amazon-B0G6ZGTG2N) for its sooner delivery, after first saying he would go with this one for its reviews. Andrew, 2026-11-08: "Need a console table for the living room, bottom left area on wall that sepaerates to kitchen. 51" wide at most, 41" tall at most (otherwise hits light switch). I need dawers, but also open space area on botom. Be mindful of Best color wood, be an experior interior designer. Use amazon only". Kept as the pick. Fit (F-20): the bottom-left wall to the kitchen, 51" long (Andrew, 2026-11-08: "the 51" is how long that part of the wall is") and 41" tall at most under a light switch, taken to start at the corner by the stair railing (its position not measured). 43.3" leaves 7.7" of the 51" (about 3 7/8" a side), and 31.5" tall it stands 9.5" under his 41" line; 11.8" deep, so the 24" kept in front of its drawers (F-32) ends 35.8" off the wall. Two drawers and an open bottom shelf. Color (F-68): a mid-brown walnut like the UGGLERUM's walnut veneer (ikea-60627980) across the room, on round tapered legs like the UGGLERUM's, so the room has one dark wood; darker than the honey-oak floor and the oak stairs, so it doesn't melt into them (F-68 (1), (4)); gold knobs that pick up the brass door knobs. Rounded ends (the page: "Rounded corners add elegance and safety") where Maddie runs past the stairs. Build: engineered wood body on FSC-certified solid pine legs (the 'Furniture Leg Material Walnut' row is the finish); 36 lb; top up to 100 lb (Maximum Weight Recommendation). Anchor it to the wall: its drawers make a step for Maddie, with the stair railing beside it (F-21, F-40); the page's one anti-tip line sits in a comparison card for a 3-drawer table, so buy a furniture strap if none comes in the box.
